notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to present the "Guns, Smoke, Two Ships" update! We've added a little bit of everything: ships, weapons, contracts, effects, optimizations, and fixes! Head to the Arcanum system to try out all this new stuff!

Added:
- New ship Strazh - a hybrid from the Order corporation.
- New ship Drakon - a next-generation fighter from the Bastion corporation.
- The new "MK-25" ship is now used by pirates.
- Added new W40 weapon - "Vector".
- New dispatcher voiceover in Order sectors - Voiced by Dasha Ostrovskaya! :)
- Added trade ship escort contracts.
- Added a new contract type - "Pirate Lair".
- The contract for a pirate station can now be obtained right near the pirate station.
- Added sector danger ratings.
- Added several new flight music tracks.
- New character: Fedya Patsan.
- Added item filters in the inventory and storage.
- Music in remote sectors is now split into several playlists - neutral and spooky.

Improvements:
- Improved engine effects.
- Made changes to NPC combat behavior.
- Significantly optimized NPCs and game physics.
- Improved autopilot behavior.
- Improved the physical flight model of ships.
- Rebalanced contract prices.
- New accelerator sound effects.

Changes:
- "Scout" and "Fighter" class ships: reduced mass, increased maneuverability, increased maximum speed.
- Reworked the loadouts of pirate ships.

Fixes:
- Fixed generator stuttering during combat.
- Fixed an issue that caused ships to self-destruct (another one).
- Fixed purchasing items on the secondary market using Ctrl.
- Increased the hitbox of station turrets.
- Reworked the targeting for guns and turrets.
- Simplified the autopilot's algorithm for entering gates.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Tired of bugs? We’ve just rolled out a PATCH with fixes and game optimizations! And of course, we couldn’t resist adding some new features! Introducing the "Dig & Smash" Update!

Added:

Interactive map now shows mineral deposits in explored sectors. You can access this info in two ways:

Via the scout’s special ability "Sector Scan."

Through mining—dig up resources, and the data will be saved on your galactic map.

This is the first of four planned iterations for mining mechanics. Three more major changes are coming soon!

Sorting objects on the sector map by distance (Thanks to Stepan Berezovsky!)

New ship ability for the INCINERATOR: "Ember Strike."

Dismantle items with the Delete key (Thanks to Flying Cancer!)

Changed:

Station preset slots increased from 5 to 15 (Big thanks to SEREGA 27RUS!)

Fixed:

Item display in the progress menu

Ship delivery bug when credits are at zero

Duplicate squad messages

Item transfer from storage to ship (ship cargo hold wasn’t being accounted for)

Visual clutter from excessive ore in space (now appears smaller)

Camera zoom distance during construction (no longer overly far)

Disappearing trade docks

Glitches in the Sisyphus cargo hold with large amounts of loot

Pirate base turrets regenerating too quickly

Overly massive turret explosions

Engine sound when docking via special ability

Optimizations:

Reduced VRAM load by compressing recently added ship and weapon textures.

Rewrote network code for cargo hold and station market synchronization.

Improved bulk-selling algorithm on the secondary market.

Fixed memory leaks on the server that were causing daily crashes.

Enjoy the game! 🚀

notes.title: Update

SPACERIFT: Arcanum System has received the "System Optimization" update!

What's new?

Added the ability to craft rare parts from simpler components (scrap metal, wiring, etc.).

Improved the hijacking and pirate surrender window.

Fixed an issue with confirming route suggestions from the OS Friend using the Y key.

Improved chat input field focus.

Fixed missing attachments in the station construction menu.

Pirate hijackers have become more aggressive in looting.

Fixed issues with the pursuit algorithm in RTA (Role Task Action).

Fixed invincible NPCs getting stuck after reconnecting to the server.

Fixed the appearance of ghost pirate bases in the middle of sectors.

notes.title: Update "Mini"
notes.notes:
The Role Task Action system has been improved; NPC freezes have been fixed, and combat strategies have been refined.

Fixed an error when accepting the contract for the global event "Destroy the Pirate Base."

Fixed the paint job for the OSF ship.

Traders and miners have been given a passive ability: increased container pickup radius.

Added two new combat tracks, each consisting of 3 stages.

Improved the in-combat music player.

Fixed a bug with pirate stations not being fully destroyed.

The best loot from the station now drops after destroying its last module.

Fixed issues with turret behavior in defense mode.

Several paid cosmetic sets have been added to the in-game store: nameplates, ship kits for Black Mouse and Typhoon (feel free to buy them). The kits do not affect ship stats (they don't even have collision), but they visually upgrade the ship nicely.

Patrol ships now use Black Mouse and are equipped with flashing lights! :)

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
The main feature of the update is the new Role Task Action system, which controls NPC behavior logic. Now bots can travel between sectors (Server Meshing technology is fully implemented and functional), and their behavior has become more complex, consisting of multiple actions.
This is the first iteration of the NPC behavior update, which opens up great prospects for the development of the quest system and the generation of in-game situations that immerse you in unique adventures.

- In addition, the following has been added:

- A new rocket launcher and "Swarm" rockets

- The "Argo" trade barge

- A remastered model of the "Decider" ship

- Various fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Captain of the third rank Reimark is in touch! Straight to the point: recently, intelligence has been reporting colossal activity of a pirate group near safe sectors. The top leadership of the Galactic Council consulted and put forward an ultimatum: it is necessary to coordinate many massive attacks on fortified enemy outposts and repel these scoundrels. They must know their place.

In connection with this news, each of you is required to download special software and update the firmware of all on-board systems.

List of apologies and innovations:
- Added a new type of GLOBAL EVENT: Attack on a pirate station
- Improved station destruction system: new effects, voice acting and all that.
- Added an interface for attacking a station: now you can better see which modules are destroyed and which remain.
- Improved algorithm for the appearance of pirate waves during a station attack
- The pirate station is restored if it is not finished off
- Turrets at the pirate station are now regenerated directly during the battle - you'll have to work a little harder
- Battle music is now tied to hostile stations
- Added drop of spare parts from pirate station modules
- Various code optimizations and more were carried out
- Added mechanics for generating a picture of a global event
- Improved ship hull damage effects and painting function
- Protect insurance is no longer available for purchase. Only Cover insurance remains (saves the ship and installed equipment, but does not save the contents of the hold).
- Fixed bugs with loot in pirate caches
- The model of the pirate cruiser "Typhoon" has been updated, now it has 10 turrets on board
- Replaced radar models

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Today, an official representative of the Galactic Council made an official statement: SPACERIFT has been updated! We recommend updating the firmware and exploring the new features!

- Added equipment wear (both current and global, limiting the number of repairs)
- Added repair menu to docks at stations
- Added mechanics for disassembling items for spare parts (5 types in total)
- Improved autopilot, now it crashes into objects less often and flies through stations
- Corporation emblems are now displayed when selecting a target (at stations, gates and ships)

Equipment repairs are carried out using spare parts, with a small payment in cosmic rubles. To get spare parts, disassemble unnecessary equipment! The more expensive the equipment, the more expensive the spare parts. The more expensive the equipment, the more times it can be repaired.

In addition, many improvements and improvements have been made:
- Fixed a bug when reloading goods from your station
- Fixed bugs with pirate caches

- Fixed a bug with a crash from the server when loading a clan emblem
- Fixed numerous bugs with loading clan emblems
- Improved UI display in light sectors
- Graphics optimizations were carried out
- Optimizations and corrections were made to the server code
- Fixed a bug with the menu freezing when overloading loot in warehouses
- Added a new model of a pirate cache
- Fixed a bug with saving screen resolution
- Fixed bugs with restrictions on the number of stations in corporations
- Fixed bugs with installing station modules inside other modules
- The station shield is now available to individual entrepreneurs :)
- Prices for production projects have been revised
- Improved display of prices for selling and purchasing items in various trade menus

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
An official statement on behalf of the Galactic Council and A-Team Corp!
On the night of September 1, new unidentified signals were noticed on the global Arcanum System Network. Numerous messages from pilots are recording new objects on radar!
After analyzing the collected data, we can make a conclusion: a game update was obviously downloaded today!

List of innovations:
- The “Sector Scanner” special ability for “Scout” type ships has been improved: now it not only opens a list of static objects (stations and wormholes), but also highlights for 15 seconds absolutely all objects that the map and radar can display. The scanner can also capture unique encrypted signals.
- Added a new type of object - dynamic containers with treasures and valuable items. Perhaps you can even find a treasure map? ;)
- The search system has been improved: now, instead of 3 types of queries, there are 2 types: search for a product for purchase, search for a product for sale (we have combined the queries “search for secondary goods” and “search for production”)
- Added a new menu to the personal section - “Progress”. There you can see what items are unlocked as you level up your rank. From there you can make a request to the search engine for a specific subject.
- OS "FRIEND" can now offer directions to the trading dock if you have a lot of items lying around in your hold that can be sold. The Y and N keys will serve as a signal to order to activate the autopilot or refuse the offer.
- OS "FRIEND" now knows the names of objects and sectors. True, we don’t use this skill everywhere yet, but we’ll start soon :)
- All NPC voice acting was re-processed and brought to approximately the same volume level. Filters and effects have also been changed. Many phrases of the OS "FRIEND" were re-recorded again (at the request of the voice actor;). A new voice-over for cash receipts has also been added.
- Added the function of COMPLETE ACCOUNT RESET in the personal section
- Fixed some UI bugs
- Fixed problems with the weapons of the WOLF ship
- Changed autopilot speed graph
- Changed the sizes of new generated sectors (reduced)
- Changed the algorithm for the appearance of clouds with lightning
- And other improvements have been made, but we don’t remember them anymore

notes.title: Update №8
notes.notes:
Hello! [/ h1]

We have been working on this update for a long time, and now the time has come to publish it!
Many of you have been following the development all this time - visiting our broadcasts, participating in discussions, sharing ideas. We want to thank you for your activity, and also remind you that our official website http://spacerift.ru has received an update in the form of a cool forum! Now you can participate in the development of the game there too :)

 List of changes and innovations 

 Content 
- New weapon for light fighters: Pulse supercharger M1
- New shield for combat corvettes
- New 24 MW generator
- New 48 MW generator
Social
- Personal rating of the player from corporations. Now your actions affect the attitude of corporations towards you. A low reputation will provide you with problems in the form of an attempted total annihilation by the patrols. Good reputation will reward you with corporate bonuses
- Player respawning now takes place at the nearest station in a sector where you are not a criminal
- If you are a criminal, you can fix your reputation by paying a fine
- Fixed a bug with the complete disappearance of the leader in the corporation, when the head leaves the corporation
Economic
- The secondary market has been improved - now the goods, of which there are a lot in the market warehouse, are cheaper
- Improved synchronization of prices in the market when trading
Player's property
- The ships have a limitation on the power of the installed generator
- Added logs of all transactions at player stations
- Added animation for grabbing a container
- Added the ability to pick up several containers at the same time
- Container display range is now equal to your radar range
- Work on fixing the problem with resetting game data (credits, experience)
- Fixed a bug with the installation of unsuitable modules on modular ships
NPC
- Added new effects for NPC ships
Quests
- Fixed the contract window when passing the tutorial
- Fixed a problem with escaping pirates in the contracts "Find and Destroy"
- Fixed hanging subtitles
Optimization
- Added LOD meshes for some ship models
- Added a mechanism to optimize VFX and SFX with a large number of ships inсекторе
Physics
- Balanced the number of containers when mining ore
- Added option to disable camera vibration in settings
- Fixed problem with damage from planets
UI
- Added an alternative sight with overheating sensors (can be disabled in the settings)
- Added fast movement of items to the warehouse and back while holding down the CTRL key
- Improved notifications about receipts of credits, experience, etc.
World
- Mined ore now lives less
- In the first two minutes, only the player who knocked it out can pick up the item
- Fixed sound of shots (when the sound comes from only one speaker)
- Fixed blueprint for industrial lasers M2
- Fixed a bug with displaying the generator when changing the module
- Improved post-processing, lighting
- Improved effects from shunting engines
- Improved effects of explosions, debris from ships, etc.

Have a nice game!
